Definition: Canonical schema-first record bundling model basis, units, entity ids, refs, privacy, and professional boundary for downstream modeling handoff.
Contract block asserting human_review_required and that the software makes no compliance/certification/sealing/approval/authentication claim.
Provider-neutral mapping of model fields to a generic downstream target system, with unsupported/approximate behavior flags.
Explicit flag marking a target behavior as unsupported/approximate/not_implemented requiring human review.
Immutable read-only snapshot of a model with JCS hashes; changes create a new model state.
Policy stating snapshot is read-only, mutations create new model state, and hash changes invalidate external acceptance.
Canonical unit-dimension vocabulary (length, force, moment, force_per_length, stress, etc.) shared across schemas, must match units.schema DimensionId enum.
Enum of model analysis states (MODEL_INCOMPLETE, MECHANICS_SOLVED, USER_RULE_CHECKED, HUMAN_REVIEW_REQUIRED, etc.) excluding CODE_COMPLIANT.
Source attribution record: source_name/location/license, contributor, contributor_certification, redistribution_status, review_status.
Structured operation (add/move/modify/delete/etc.) routed through validation, never a direct model mutation.
Non-mutating preview of an operation's before/after state held for user review.
Record of explicit user acceptance/rejection of operations without mutating the accepted model state.
Canonical model role; analytical_solver_model derives from it via physical_to_analytical traceability.
Typed link (physical_to_analytical, state_snapshot, analysis_run, comparison, handoff, etc.) connecting model artifacts.
Contract handing a global centerline-frame model region to an optional local shell/solid analysis, with guidance labels and human review.
Validation gate accepting/rejecting/quarantining library imports based on provenance, redistribution rights, and unit metadata.
Native self-describing JSON export package with checksummed members, stable id map, and loss report.
Schema-first headless runner interface (solve/validate/export/benchmark/regression) with many TBD invocation decisions.
Invented public nonlinear support regression fixtures (ActiveSet, Gap, LiftOff, Friction, NonConvergence) with fixture-local unit basis and TBD tolerances.
sqlite_local_project_store profile (SCA-003) acting as a rebuildable index projection over canonical JCS JSON truth; no hosted DB or network.
